summary: HDFC Bank filed a routine Form 6-K on September 14, 2026 (period September 11, 2026) disclosing that Niche Ninety Nine Capability and Certifications (OPC) Private Limited assigned the bank an unsolicited ESG rating of 77.78 on September 11, 2026. The bank expressly states it did not engage the rating agency and that the rating was prepared independently from public-domain information. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is involved. This is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer disclosure analogous to a US Form 8-K; no deal or special-situation risk-arb angle applies.
